notes: All Buick catalogs (oldcarbrochures.org scans) count as ONE manufacturer source; all Wikipedia articles count as ONE source.
EPA Gas Mileage Guides (1975-77) and EPA fueleconomy.gov data (1984+) are one EPA source; CARB executive orders are a separate (state) government source. Neither gives horsepower.

HP is SAE net throughout. NHRA headings used: SKYLARK, SKYLARK LIMITED, SKYLARK SPORT, SKYLARK CUSTOM (1982-84). 1975 Apollo sedan and 1985-87 Somerset/Somerset Regal coupe are separate models and excluded.
GM engine-family codes in CARB orders carry a division digit (1 Chevrolet, 2 Pontiac, 3 Oldsmobile, 4 Buick), used to corroborate builders.
CARB server began returning 403 after index probing; further 1978 and 1981-83 151-CID orders were not retrieved.
